---
title: "MAGiC downscaling training"
---

This is the downscaling half of the MAGiC system. It picks up where
[magic-ensemble](https://github.com/ccmmf/magic-training) stops: the ensemble workflow
runs SIPNET at a set of design points, and this workflow turns that into carbon
estimates for every crop field in California, then aggregates to county and state.

Running SIPNET at all 385,234 fields is not affordable. The design points are chosen to
span the state's covariate space, a Random Forest learns covariates to model output at
those points, and applies it everywhere else. One forest is fit per ensemble member, so
the ensemble's parameter uncertainty propagates to the field level rather than
collapsing to a single number.

Each notebook is a self-study demo to work through beforehand, then discuss in the live
session.

Topic | Audience | Objectives | Notes
--|--|--|--
[Environment setup](CARB-downscaling-setup.md) | Everyone | Conda, AWS, and the CLI's `yq` requirement | Needed before the inventory notebook
[Inventory downscaling](downscaling_inventory.qmd) | MAGiC users | Turn an ensemble run into field, county and state carbon | Demo bundle is four Delta counties, runs in about ten minutes
Scenario downscaling | MAGiC users | Practice-change arms and scenario deltas | Deferred; same four commands with a longer scenario list
Design point selection | Data managers | How the design points are chosen | Scripts 010-022, upstream of the ensemble and not a CLI command

## Commands

Each is one CLI verb. The steps inside are declared in
[`downscaling_manifest.yaml`](../../downscaling_manifest.yaml), not hard coded.

Command | What it does
--|--
`get-demo-data` | Downloads and extracts the demo bundle. Run once, before `prepare`.
`prepare` | Stages ensemble output and data layers into `run_dir`.
`extract` | Reads SIPNET NetCDF, reshapes to EFI long format.
`downscale` | Random Forest downscaling to all fields, then county and state aggregation.
`analyze` | Diagnostics, uncertainty, maps.

## Data flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  ENS["magic-ensemble\nSIPNET at design points"] --> PREP["prepare"]
  PREP --> EXT["extract"]
  EXT --> DS["downscale"]
  DS --> AN["analyze"]
```

## Audiences

Following the same roles as the [MAGiC training index](https://github.com/ccmmf/magic-training):

* **Everyone** -- environment setup.
* **MAGiC users** -- running the workflow and reading its output. Assumes the setup
  notebook is done and you are comfortable on the command line.
* **Data managers** -- regenerating the design points or the covariate layers.
